@graph.name: Rasta Pasta
@graph.description: This easy Rasta Pasta recipe has jerk-seasoned chicken, colorful peppers, and a creamy Parmesan sauce. All made in one pot in just 45 minutes!

recipeInstructions.text: Dice onion, slice bell peppers, and mince garlic.
recipeInstructions.name: Prep fresh ingredients

recipeInstructions.text: Slice each chicken breast horizontally in half to create four thin cutlets. Season both sides with about 1 tablespoon of the jerk seasoning.
recipeInstructions.name: Filet the chicken

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through with the temperature reading at least 165°F. Transfer the chicken to a plate to rest.
recipeInstructions.name: Cook the chicken

recipeInstructions.text: Add the onion and bell peppers to the same pot. Cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften and the browned bits from the chicken have loosened from the bottom of the pot.
recipeInstructions.name: Saute the veggies

recipeInstructions.text: Add the garlic and remaining ½ tablespoon jerk seasoning. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
recipeInstructions.name: Add garlic and seasoning

recipeInstructions.text: Add the penne and chicken broth. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Cook uncovered for 8-10 minutes, stirring frequently (see notes) so the pasta doesn't stick, until the pasta is nearly tender and most of the broth has been absorbed.
recipeInstructions.name: Cook the pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Stir in the half-and-half and continue cooking for 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently, until the pasta is tender and the sauce is creamy.
recipeInstructions.name: Make it creamy

recipeInstructions.text: Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the Parmesan. If the sauce is thicker than you'd like, add a splash of water or broth.
recipeInstructions.name: Add the cheese

recipeInstructions.text: Slice the chicken into strips, cutting against the grain to keep the chicken juicy. (see notes)
recipeInstructions.name: Slice the chicken

recipeInstructions.text: Add sliced chicken onto pasta and finish with sliced green onion and a squeeze of fresh lime if desired. Enjoy.
recipeInstructions.name: Garnish and serve
